main_text.l: planè notoria alicui illata sit, ut in
Quaestionibus facti item vitae & morum evi-
dentior esse res solet, quàm in Quaestionibus
à Principibus Iudæ;si autem injuria non sit
adeò notoria, ut in Quaestionibus fidei
peram dare, ut à majore conventu Ec-
clesiastico seu Synodo legitimâ res deci-
datur, prout in vetere Ecclesiâ secundum
Dord. Constit. Eccles. art. 37. & D. D.
QUÆST. VIII. An Magistratus habeat potestatem leges ferendi Ecclesiasticas?
BEllarminus negat, & Magistratui tantum tribuit potestatem leges ferendi

page.notes: Top right "Q. VII." is a question number beside the running head, left out of the running head because it is a number. A small mark follows "Magistratus" in the first paragraph (possibly a reference sign); it is not transcribed, no matching note is printed. "Maigstratus" is a printing error for "Magistratus", kept as printed. "Iudæ;si" is printed without a space, kept as printed. A stray dot appears after "communicationem" in "Excommunicationem Papalem"; not transcribed. The "B" of the last paragraph is a large initial joined to "Ellarminus". The paragraph continues past the scan's last line, so it is not closed.
